metadata.title: Machine-checked involution theorems in Lean 4 — 75 theorems, axiom accounting, 3 candidate originals
metadata.description:
A machine-checked corpus of 75 theorems in Lean 4, across 11 files, compiling with no Mathlib and no sorry.

This deposit proves no Clay Millennium Prize Problem. The corpus contains a theorem saying so, Corpus.clay_sealed_count_is_zero, which computes that its registry of prize-grade proofs is empty; a companion theorem, Corpus.computable_is_not_solved, states that recomputing a path entails nothing about a prize problem. An earlier version of this record claimed the opposite. It was wrong, and this version exists to correct it.

What is actually established. Of the 75 theorems, machine verification reports that the great majority depend on NO axiom at all — they are decided by computation in the kernel, so the proof is the computation and nothing is assumed — and the remainder depend on propext alone, which is one of Lean’s three foundational axioms and is what its own core arithmetic reasons through. None depends on Classical.choice, and none on sorryAx. That accounting is re-derived on every run by asking the kernel with #print axioms, never by restating it.

Priority is claimed over 3 results, each with a prior-art search on record that returned nothing:

  • Closure is one hundred sixty two (three.lean)
  • The closure is eighty one orbits (three.lean)
  • Reflection complements the address (three.lean)

The remaining 72 are FORMALISATIONS of known results and each carries its citation. Nothing here claims to have discovered the pinhole camera, central inversion, or row-major addressing.

A DOI dates an expression; it does not establish novelty. What is claimed above is the expression, dated by this deposit.
metadata.notes: This deposit CORRECTS the record at 10.5281/zenodo.21787144, which claimed complete quantum proofs of the Clay Millennium Problems. That claim is false and is refuted by a theorem inside the corpus itself (Corpus.clay_sealed_count_is_zero), and the repository has recorded the paper as withdrawn since 2026-08-20. Publish this as an INDEPENDENT deposit with its own DOI, relating back to the earlier record — NOT as a new version under concept 10.5281/zenodo.21787143, which resolves to a different work and whose version chain is shared by three unrelated projects.
